shorts.title: What you will learn: Setting up and compiling
shorts.hook: Three tools are all you need to write C plus plus.
shorts.script: Three tools are all you need to write C plus plus. Today we set up your computer. You need only three tools. By the end, you build and run a real program. You need three tools. The editor is where you type your code. We use Visual Studio Code. The compiler builds your program. We use g plus plus, from the GCC family. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Setting up and compiling.

shorts.title: Setting up and compiling in one minute
shorts.script: You need three tools. The editor is where you type your code. We use Visual Studio Code. The compiler builds your program. We use g plus plus, from the GCC family. The terminal is where you type commands and run programs. Think of a kitchen. The editor is the notebook with the recipe. The compiler is the stove. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.caption: Setting up and compiling in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: A built-in name holds a number for the language version.
shorts.script: A built-in name holds a number for the language version. The name starts with two underscores, then c plus plus. With the flag std equals c plus plus twenty, the number is two zero two zero zero two. That number means C plus plus twenty. We use this version in the whole course. Type g plus plus, then the flags dash std equals c plus plus twenty, dash Wall and dash Wextra. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing include
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. Here the include line is missing. The compiler says cout is not a member of std. It even tells you what to do. It asks if you forgot to include iostream. Add the include line at the top, and the error goes away. The compiler only knows cout after you include the iostream header. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: A MISSING INCLUDE
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing include.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Why did the programmer install three tools? Because two was a bug, and four was a feature.
shorts.script: Why did the programmer install three tools? Because two was a bug, and four was a feature. Type setup dot cpp, compile it with g plus plus, and run it. Then change one message and compile again. Write your answer in the comments. You need an editor, a compiler and a terminal. The command g plus plus builds your file into a program. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
